description: Connect advertising accounts to analyze campaign performance, inspect recommendations, and review changes in a compact Before/After preview. Compare spend, clicks, conversions, and ROAS while keeping account currencies separate. Changes follow the policies configured for your Adport workspace and are recorded in its audit trail. Requires an Adport account and access to the advertising accounts you want to manage.

defaultPrompt: Show the ad accounts I can access and their status.
Compare campaign spend, clicks, conversions and ROAS for the last 7 days. Keep currencies separate.
Help me review a campaign budget change with a Before/After preview. Do not apply it.
